title: Autonomy and Coordination in Intelligent Manufacturing: A Recursive Autonomous Agent Framework
title_zh: 智能制造中的自主性与协调性：递归自主智能体框架

paragraphs.en: Intelligent production requires systems to make decisions and organize work according to production goals and operating conditions. It also requires continuous adjustment through feedback. This paper analyzes intelligence in human production organizations from a complex adaptive systems (CAS) perspective. The analysis identifies two coupled mechanisms: individual autonomy and collective coordination. Individual autonomy enables actors to form local decisions using available information. Collective coordination aligns these decisions with shared goals and joint constraints. Learning and adaptation improve both mechanisms over time. A production-system model formalizes how local decision rules and coordination jointly form system decisions. On this basis, we propose the Recursive Autonomous Agent (RAA) framework, which combines goal-driven autonomous agents with a recursive organizational structure. Goal contracts define local objectives and operating boundaries, while capability contracts support the selection and composition of production units. Common interfaces allow coordinated groups to participate as units in larger organizations, connecting equipment, production lines, and factories. RAA thus provides an engineering approach to next-generation intelligent manufacturing, translating the requirements of intelligence, openness, and system-wide integration into mechanisms for autonomous and coordinated production.
paragraphs.zh: 智能生产要求系统根据生产目标和运行状态做出决策并组织工作。 这还要求通过反馈进行持续调整。 本文从复杂适应系统（CAS）的视角分析人类生产组织中的智能。 该分析识别出两个耦合机制：个体自主与集体协调。 个体自主使行动者能够利用可获得的信息形成局部决策。 集体协调使这些决策与共同目标和联合约束保持一致。 学习与适应会随时间不断改进这两个机制。 一个生产系统模型形式化了局部决策规则与协调如何共同构成系统决策。 在此基础上，我们提出递归自主智能体（RAA）框架，该框架将目标驱动的自主智能体与递归的组织结构相结合。 目标契约定义局部目标和运行边界，而能力契约支持生产单元的选择与组合。 通用接口使协调后的群组能够作为单元参与更大的组织，从而连接设备、产线和工厂。 因此，RAA 为下一代智能制造提供了一种工程化路径，将智能、开放和全系统集成的要求转化为自主与协调生产的机制。

paragraphs.en: A factory must turn changing orders into products that meet delivery, quality, and safety requirements. It must also deal with changes in equipment and resources. A fixed program can handle repeated operations under familiar conditions. A new order, a failed machine, or a material delay may require a different plan. People then have to assess the situation and organize a response. This need becomes more pressing as product variety grows and production batches become smaller [ 6 , 7 ] . Digital systems make production easier to describe and monitor. Networks make information available across equipment and departments. Digital twins strengthen the link between physical operations and their digital representations [ 9 ] . These capabilities support decisions, but access to information does not itself decide how production should proceed. The practical question is how a system can use the information it has to choose actions and revise them as conditions change.

paragraphs.en: The question has both a local and a collective side. A workstation needs to understand its task, select suitable operations, and check the result. A production line must also manage shared resources and dependencies between workstations. A locally sensible choice can disrupt another task. The ability of each unit to act and the ability of the organization to coordinate those actions must therefore be developed together. Human production organizations offer a useful reference. An operator observes conditions at a station and adjusts work within an assigned responsibility. A team leader handles issues that affect several stations. A manager connects these arrangements to broader production objectives. Problems and results move upward, while goals and work assignments move downward. This organization combines independent judgment with coordinated action. It provides a functional reference for engineering, rather than a requirement to reproduce human cognition.
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题既有局部的一面，也有整体的一面。 一个工作站需要理解自己的任务，选择合适的操作，并检查结果。 一条生产线还必须管理共享资源以及工作站之间的依赖关系。 一个在局部合理的选择可能干扰另一个任务。 因此，每个单元的行动能力与组织协调这些行动的能力必须共同发展。 人类的生产组织提供了一个有用的参照。 操作员观察工位上的状况，并在被分配的职责范围内调整工作。 班组长处理影响多个工位的问题。 经理将这些安排与更宏观的生产目标联系起来。 问题和结果向上传递，而目标和工作分配向下传达。 这种组织将独立判断与协调行动结合在一起。 它为工程设计提供了一种功能性参照，而不是要求复现人类认知。

paragraphs.en: We examine this reference through complex adaptive systems (CAS) theory [ 2 , 4 ] . CAS focuses on interacting actors that adapt using local information and feedback. It also draws attention to outcomes that depend on how actors interact. This perspective connects the decisions made by production units to the performance of the organization as a whole. Our central account has two parts. Individual autonomy explains how production actors form and revise local decisions. Collective coordination explains how these decisions become joint action under shared constraints. Learning and adaptation develop both mechanisms. On this basis, we present the Recursive Autonomous Agent (RAA) framework. It combines goal-driven agents with a recursive structure for organizing their work.

Second, it maps these roles to engineering requirements and a recursive agent framework. The design links local execution to broader production goals through contracts, feedback, and coordination across levels.

paragraphs.en: A skilled worker illustrates the required cycle. The worker checks the equipment and workpiece, decides how to perform the operation, carries it out, and inspects the result. Feedback informs the next action. If a deviation can be corrected locally, the worker makes the correction. Otherwise, the issue is reported for coordination. The engineering requirement is a similar connection between observation, decision, execution, and feedback.

sents.en: If a deviation can be corrected locally, the worker makes the correction.
sents.zh: 如果偏差可以在本地纠正，工人就进行纠正。

sents.en: Otherwise, the issue is reported for coordination.
sents.zh: 否则，该问题会被上报以便协调。

sents.en: The engineering requirement is a similar connection between observation, decision, execution, and feedback.
sents.zh: 工程上的需求是观察、决策、执行与反馈之间类似的连接。

paragraphs.en: Individual autonomy is the ability of a production actor to use local information to pursue an assigned goal within defined boundaries. The actor maintains a local feedback loop and handles execution deviations within its authority.
paragraphs.zh: 个体自治是指生产参与者在其边界范围内利用本地信息追求被分配目标的能力。 该参与者维护本地反馈回路，并在其权限范围内处理执行偏差。

sents.en: Individual autonomy is the ability of a production actor to use local information to pursue an assigned goal within defined boundaries.
sents.zh: 个体自治是指生产参与者在其边界范围内利用本地信息追求被分配目标的能力。

sents.en: The actor maintains a local feedback loop and handles execution deviations within its authority.

paragraphs.en: Four requirements follow from this definition:
paragraphs.zh: 从这个定义中可以得出四个要求：

paragraphs.en: The actor receives and interprets its assigned objective.
paragraphs.zh: 执行器接收并解释其被分配的目标。

paragraphs.en: Observation, decision, execution, and feedback remain connected during operation.
paragraphs.zh: 在运行过程中，观察、决策、执行和反馈保持相互连接。

paragraphs.en: The actor corrects local execution problems within its authority.
paragraphs.zh: 执行器在其权限范围内纠正本地执行问题。

paragraphs.en: The actor improves its decisions through experience without bypassing operating boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 行动者通过经验改进其决策，同时不越过运行边界。

paragraphs.en: These requirements concern more than the ability to issue an action. They connect the assigned goal to the observed result. They also distinguish a correction made during execution from a change to the model or policy used in later work.
paragraphs.zh: 这些要求涉及的内容不止是发出一个动作的能力。 它们将分配的目标与观察到的结果联系起来。 它们还区分了执行过程中做出的纠正与对后续工作所使用的模型或策略的更改。

paragraphs.en: Autonomous action alone does not organize a production system. Two units may need the same machine at the same time. A downstream station may depend on an upstream task that has not finished. A handoff may fail even when both stations can perform their own operations. These dependencies make the relationship between actions part of the decision problem.
paragraphs.zh: 仅靠自主行动并不能组织起一个生产系统。 两个单元可能同时需要同一台机器。 下游工位可能依赖一个尚未完成的上游任务。 即使两个工位都能完成各自的操作，交接仍可能失败。 这些依赖关系使得行动之间的关系成为决策问题的一部分。

sents.en: Autonomous action alone does not organize a production system.

sents.en: A downstream station may depend on an upstream task that has not finished.
sents.zh: 下游工位可能依赖一个尚未完成的上游任务。

sents.en: A handoff may fail even when both stations can perform their own operations.
sents.zh: 即使两个工位都能完成各自的操作，交接仍可能失败。

sents.en: These dependencies make the relationship between actions part of the decision problem.
sents.zh: 这些依赖关系使得行动之间的关系成为决策问题的一部分。

paragraphs.en: There are two reasons to coordinate. The first is joint feasibility. An action can be allowed at each station in isolation but disallowed when the stations act together. The second is the dependence of overall results on interaction. Having every machine available does not guarantee timely production. Task order, resource allocation, and handoffs can change the outcome of the whole process.
paragraphs.zh: 协调有两个原因。 首先是联合可行性。 一个动作在每个站点单独来看是允许的，但当各站点一起行动时却可能不被允许。 其次是整体结果对交互的依赖。 每台机器都可用并不能保证及时的生产。 任务顺序、资源分配和交接可以改变整个流程的结果。

sents.zh: 每台机器都可用并不能保证及时的生产。

sents.en: Task order, resource allocation, and handoffs can change the outcome of the whole process.
sents.zh: 任务顺序、资源分配和交接可以改变整个流程的结果。

paragraphs.en: Collective coordination is the ability of several autonomous actors to form jointly feasible system decisions in pursuit of a shared goal. It establishes the relationships needed for joint work and adjusts or ends them when conditions change.
paragraphs.zh: 集体协调是多个自主行动者为追求共同目标而形成联合可行的系统决策的能力。 它建立共同工作所需的关系，并在条件变化时调整或终止这些关系。

sents.en: It establishes the relationships needed for joint work and adjusts or ends them when conditions change.
sents.zh: 它建立共同工作所需的关系，并在条件变化时调整或终止这些关系。

paragraphs.en: This mechanism has four corresponding requirements:
paragraphs.zh: 该机制有四项对应的要求：

paragraphs.en: The organization identifies a common objective and explains how local tasks contribute to it.
paragraphs.zh: 该组织确定一个共同目标，并解释各个局部任务如何为此目标做出贡献。

paragraphs.en: It brings together actors with suitable capabilities and specifies how they will work together.
paragraphs.zh: 它将具备合适能力的智能体汇聚在一起，并规定它们将如何协同工作。

paragraphs.en: It coordinates local proposals into feasible system action and supports their execution.
paragraphs.zh: 它将本地提案协调为可行的系统行动，并支持其执行。

paragraphs.en: It uses feedback to assess collective results and revise the organization of work.
paragraphs.zh: 它利用反馈来评估集体成果并调整工作的组织方式。

paragraphs.en: Coordination therefore includes both preparing an organization and managing its operation. Suitable participants must first be found. Their proposed actions must then satisfy shared constraints. Execution feedback may require changes to task assignments, resources, or coordination relationships.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，协调既包括对组织进行筹备，也包括对其运作进行管理。 首先必须找到合适的参与者。 然后，他们提出的行动必须满足共享的约束条件。 执行反馈可能需要对任务分配、资源或协调关系进行调整。

paragraphs.en: The two mechanisms answer different questions. Individual autonomy asks what an actor should do using the information it has. Collective coordination asks how the proposed actions can work together. Figure 1 shows the connection. Local decisions become proposals for joint work. Shared constraints determine which combinations can be executed. The resulting feedback informs both the actors and their organization.

paragraphs.en: Without individual autonomy, a central system would have to guide each local response and could become slow when conditions change. Without collective coordination, actors could compete for resources or pursue incompatible local objectives. A complete account of production decisions must cover both the actors’ internal activity and their relationships.
paragraphs.zh: 如果没有个体自主性，中央系统就必须指导每一个局部响应，在条件变化时可能变得迟缓。 如果没有集体协调，各行动者可能会争夺资源或追求互不相容的局部目标。 对生产决策的完整说明必须既涵盖行动者的内部活动，也涵盖他们之间的关系。

paragraphs.en: At this level of description, the paper treats autonomy and coordination as a minimal and complete pair. The first covers the internal path from a local goal to an outcome. The second covers the relationships needed for a joint outcome. Sensing, planning, execution, and learning belong to the actor’s activity. Task allocation, negotiation, shared resources, and feedback aggregation concern relationships among actors. Learning and adaptation operate within both parts of this account. An actor can improve a local model or decision rule. An organization can improve participant selection or change a coordination relationship. These processes develop autonomy and coordination over time; they are not introduced here as a third mechanism alongside them.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一描述层次上，论文将自主性与协调视为一组最小且完备的配对。 前者涵盖从局部目标到结果的内部路径。 后者涵盖实现联合结果所需的关系。 感知、规划、执行和学习属于行动者的活动。 任务分配、协商、共享资源和反馈汇聚则涉及行动者之间的关系。 学习与适应在这两部分中都发挥作用。 智能体可以改进其局部模型或决策规则。 组织可以改进参与者选择或改变某一协调关系。 这些过程随时间推移发展自主性与协调；此处并未将它们作为与二者并列的第三种机制引入。

paragraphs.en: The design separates artificial intelligence (AI) proposals from physical execution. AI can interpret a task and propose a plan. paragraphs.en: A constraint engine monitors operation. When results depart from the plan, the agent first checks whether it can recover within its authority. It may retry an operation or revise its plan. Where permitted, it can use an alternative method or continue with reduced capability. If it cannot resolve the problem within its limits, it escalates the issue or stops safely. The event and the actions taken are recorded.

paragraphs.en: Operational correction and learning run on different time scales. The fast process uses existing models, skills, and boundaries to correct deviations or replan. The slower process collects experience and proposes changes to a model, rule, or policy. Proposed updates pass offline evaluation, simulation, constraint checks, and version approval before use. Experience can therefore improve later decisions without allowing the update process to bypass physical operating limits.
paragraphs.zh: 运行中的纠偏与学习在不同的时间尺度上进行。 快过程使用现有的模型、技能和边界来纠正偏差或重新规划。 较慢的过程收集经验，并对模型、规则或策略提出变更。 提出的更新在使用前须通过离线评估、仿真、约束检查和版本审批。 因此，经验可以改进后续决策，同时不允许更新过程绕过物理运行极限。

sents.en: Operational correction and learning run on different time scales.
sents.zh: 运行中的纠偏与学习在不同的时间尺度上进行。

sents.en: The fast process uses existing models, skills, and boundaries to correct deviations or replan.
sents.zh: 快过程使用现有的模型、技能和边界来纠正偏差或重新规划。

sents.en: The slower process collects experience and proposes changes to a model, rule, or policy.
sents.zh: 较慢的过程收集经验，并对模型、规则或策略提出变更。

sents.en: Proposed updates pass offline evaluation, simulation, constraint checks, and version approval before use.
sents.zh: 提出的更新在使用前须通过离线评估、仿真、约束检查和版本审批。

sents.en: Experience can therefore improve later decisions without allowing the update process to bypass physical operating limits.
sents.zh: 因此，经验可以改进后续决策，同时不允许更新过程绕过物理运行极限。

paragraphs.en: A level-two agent receives a production objective and divides it into interdependent subtasks. Each subtask has an acceptance criterion, so its contribution to the overall result can be checked. Completion is assessed through the decomposition and the associated requirements, rather than from an informal report that each participant has finished.
paragraphs.zh: 二级智能体接收一个生产目标，并将其分解为相互依赖的子任务。 每个子任务都有一个验收标准，因此可以检验其对整体结果的贡献。 完成情况通过该分解及相应的需求来评估，而不是依据各参与者已完成的非正式报告。

sents.en: A level-two agent receives a production objective and divides it into interdependent subtasks.
sents.zh: 二级智能体接收一个生产目标，并将其分解为相互依赖的子任务。

sents.en: Each subtask has an acceptance criterion, so its contribution to the overall result can be checked.
sents.zh: 每个子任务都有一个验收标准，因此可以检验其对整体结果的贡献。

sents.en: Completion is assessed through the decomposition and the associated requirements, rather than from an informal report that each participant has finished.
sents.zh: 完成情况通过该分解及相应的需求来评估，而不是依据各参与者已完成的非正式报告。

paragraphs.en: The organization finds participants through capability contracts. Each contract states what an agent can do, the conditions it needs, the effects and quality it can provide, and the resources it uses. The level-two agent combines this information with current availability and state. It then selects participants, assigns roles, and establishes working relationships.
paragraphs.zh: 该组织通过能力契约来寻找参与者。 每份契约说明一个智能体能做什么、它所需的条件、它能提供的效果和质量，以及它所使用的资源。 二级智能体将这些信息与当前的可用性和状态相结合。 然后，它选择参与者、分配角色，并建立工作关系。

sents.en: The organization finds participants through capability contracts.
sents.zh: 该组织通过能力契约来寻找参与者。

sents.en: Each contract states what an agent can do, the conditions it needs, the effects and quality it can provide, and the resources it uses.
sents.zh: 每份契约说明一个智能体能做什么、它所需的条件、它能提供的效果和质量，以及它所使用的资源。

sents.en: The level-two agent combines this information with current availability and state.
sents.zh: 二级智能体将这些信息与当前的可用性和状态相结合。

sents.en: It then selects participants, assigns roles, and establishes working relationships.
sents.zh: 然后，它选择参与者、分配角色，并建立工作关系。

paragraphs.en: The planning question is expressed in terms of required capabilities. A task does not have to remain tied to a particular device. A replacement device can participate when its interfaces are adapted and its capabilities meet the relevant contract. Capability verification remains necessary; a matching name alone is not enough to establish that two devices can perform the same work.
paragraphs.zh: 规划问题以所需能力的形式来表达。 任务不必绑定在特定设备上。 当替换设备的接口经过适配且其能力满足相关契约时，该设备即可参与。 能力验证仍然是必要的；仅凭名称匹配不足以确定两个设备能够执行相同的工作。

sents.en: The planning question is expressed in terms of required capabilities.
sents.zh: 规划问题以所需能力的形式来表达。

sents.en: A task does not have to remain tied to a particular device.
sents.zh: 任务不必绑定在特定设备上。

sents.en: A replacement device can participate when its interfaces are adapted and its capabilities meet the relevant contract.
sents.zh: 当替换设备的接口经过适配且其能力满足相关契约时，该设备即可参与。

sents.en: Capability verification remains necessary; a matching name alone is not enough to establish that two devices can perform the same work.
sents.zh: 能力验证仍然是必要的；仅凭名称匹配不足以确定两个设备能够执行相同的工作。

paragraphs.en: Level-one agents propose local actions. The level-two agent checks their combination against resource restrictions, task order, and handoff requirements. It forms an executable joint decision and coordinates the resulting work. Protocols specify how participants exchange state, hand over tasks, and confirm results. These mechanisms implement the role of μ \mu in Equation ( 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 一级智能体提出局部动作。 二级智能体根据资源限制、任务顺序和交接要求检查它们的组合。 它形成可执行的联合决策并协调由此产生的工作。 协议规定了参与者如何交换状态、移交任务和确认结果。 这些机制实现了式（8）中 μ \mu 的作用。

sents.en: Level-one agents propose local actions.
sents.zh: 一级智能体提出局部动作。

sents.en: The level-two agent checks their combination against resource restrictions, task order, and handoff requirements.
sents.zh: 二级智能体根据资源限制、任务顺序和交接要求检查它们的组合。

sents.en: It forms an executable joint decision and coordinates the resulting work.
sents.zh: 它形成可执行的联合决策并协调由此产生的工作。

sents.en: Protocols specify how participants exchange state, hand over tasks, and confirm results.
sents.zh: 协议规定了参与者如何交换状态、移交任务和确认结果。

sents.en: These mechanisms implement the role of μ \mu in Equation ( 8 ).
sents.zh: 这些机制实现了式（8）中 μ \mu 的作用。

paragraphs.en: During execution, participants report their states, results, exceptions, and supporting evidence. The level-two agent uses these reports in its own observation–decision–execution–feedback loop. It assesses progress and overall outcomes. It can revise assignments or resource allocation, change participants, or adjust coordination relationships. Completed coordination records provide experience for later selection and organization decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 在执行过程中，各参与方上报其状态、结果、异常及支撑证据。 二级智能体在其自身的观察—决策—执行—反馈循环中使用这些上报信息。 它评估进展与整体成果。 它可以修订任务分配或资源调配、更换参与方，或调整协作关系。 已完成的协作记录为后续的选择与组织决策提供经验。

sents.en: During execution, participants report their states, results, exceptions, and supporting evidence.
sents.zh: 在执行过程中，各参与方上报其状态、结果、异常及支撑证据。

sents.en: The level-two agent uses these reports in its own observation–decision–execution–feedback loop.
sents.zh: 二级智能体在其自身的观察—决策—执行—反馈循环中使用这些上报信息。

sents.en: It assesses progress and overall outcomes.
sents.zh: 它评估进展与整体成果。

sents.en: It can revise assignments or resource allocation, change participants, or adjust coordination relationships.
sents.zh: 它可以修订任务分配或资源调配、更换参与方，或调整协作关系。

sents.en: Completed coordination records provide experience for later selection and organization decisions.
sents.zh: 已完成的协作记录为后续的选择与组织决策提供经验。

paragraphs.en: Recursion follows from the external interface. Both a level-one agent and a level-two organization can receive goals and constraints, describe capabilities, and report results. A higher-level agent can therefore call on a coordinated group as one production unit. At each level, goals are decomposed downward and results are brought together upward. The same organizational pattern can be repeated at a broader production scale.
paragraphs.zh: 递归由外部接口导出。 一级智能体和二级组织都可以接收目标与约束、描述自身能力并汇报结果。 因此，更高层的智能体可以把一个协同的群体当作一个生产单元来调用。 在每一层级上，目标向下分解，结果向上汇聚。 同样的组织模式可以在更广的生产规模上重复使用。

sents.en: Recursion follows from the external interface.
sents.zh: 递归由外部接口导出。

sents.en: Both a level-one agent and a level-two organization can receive goals and constraints, describe capabilities, and report results.
sents.zh: 一级智能体和二级组织都可以接收目标与约束、描述自身能力并汇报结果。

sents.en: A higher-level agent can therefore call on a coordinated group as one production unit.
sents.zh: 因此，更高层的智能体可以把一个协同的群体当作一个生产单元来调用。

sents.en: At each level, goals are decomposed downward and results are brought together upward.
sents.zh: 在每一层级上，目标向下分解，结果向上汇聚。

sents.en: The same organizational pattern can be repeated at a broader production scale.
sents.zh: 同样的组织模式可以在更广的生产规模上重复使用。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 illustrates the design with three equipment tasks: processing, inspection, and material handling. Each level-one agent maintains its local feedback loop. A level-two agent coordinates their work toward a production-line objective. Personnel or an existing management system set the overall goal and constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 展示了包含三个设备任务的设计：加工、检测和物料搬运。 每个一级智能体维护其本地反馈回路。 一个二级智能体协调它们的工作，以实现生产线目标。 人员或现有的管理系统设定总体目标和约束条件。

sents.en: Figure 2 illustrates the design with three equipment tasks: processing, inspection, and material handling.
sents.zh: 图 2 展示了包含三个设备任务的设计：加工、检测和物料搬运。

sents.en: Each level-one agent maintains its local feedback loop.
sents.zh: 每个一级智能体维护其本地反馈回路。

sents.en: A level-two agent coordinates their work toward a production-line objective.
sents.zh: 一个二级智能体协调它们的工作，以实现生产线目标。

sents.en: Personnel or an existing management system set the overall goal and constraints.
sents.zh: 人员或现有的管理系统设定总体目标和约束条件。

paragraphs.en: The processing agent observes the workpiece and tool, chooses an operation, and checks quality and completion. The inspection agent compares measurements with acceptance criteria and returns pass or fail evidence. The material-handling agent checks locations and path conditions. It selects a route and handoff, then confirms delivery. Each agent invokes validated skills within physical operating limits.
paragraphs.zh: 加工智能体观察工件和刀具，选择操作，并检查质量与完成情况。 检验智能体将测量结果与验收标准进行比较，并返回合格或不合格的证据。 物料搬运智能体检查位置和路径条件。 它选择路线和交接方式，然后确认交付。 每个智能体在物理运行限制内调用经过验证的技能。

sents.en: The processing agent observes the workpiece and tool, chooses an operation, and checks quality and completion.
sents.zh: 加工智能体观察工件和刀具，选择操作，并检查质量与完成情况。

sents.en: The inspection agent compares measurements with acceptance criteria and returns pass or fail evidence.
sents.zh: 检验智能体将测量结果与验收标准进行比较，并返回合格或不合格的证据。

sents.en: The material-handling agent checks locations and path conditions.
sents.zh: 物料搬运智能体检查位置和路径条件。

sents.en: It selects a route and handoff, then confirms delivery.
sents.zh: 它选择路线和交接方式，然后确认交付。

sents.en: Each agent invokes validated skills within physical operating limits.
sents.zh: 每个智能体在物理运行限制内调用经过验证的技能。

paragraphs.en: Specify the outcome. Personnel or the management system supply the production goal and its boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 明确结果。 人员或管理系统提供生产目标及其边界。

sents.en: Specify the outcome.
sents.zh: 明确结果。

sents.en: Personnel or the management system supply the production goal and its boundaries.
sents.zh: 人员或管理系统提供生产目标及其边界。

paragraphs.en: Organize the work. The level-two agent decomposes the goal, matches subtasks to capabilities, checks joint constraints, and assigns work.
paragraphs.zh: 组织工作。 二级智能体将目标分解，把子任务与能力进行匹配，检查联合约束，并分配工作。

sents.en: Organize the work.
sents.zh: 组织工作。

sents.en: The level-two agent decomposes the goal, matches subtasks to capabilities, checks joint constraints, and assigns work.
sents.zh: 二级智能体将目标分解，把子任务与能力进行匹配，检查联合约束，并分配工作。

paragraphs.en: Execute locally. Each level-one agent acts within its boundaries and reports state, progress, and evidence of the result.
paragraphs.zh: 本地执行。 每个一级智能体在其职责范围内行动，并报告状态、进度和结果的证据。

sents.en: Execute locally.
sents.zh: 本地执行。

sents.en: Each level-one agent acts within its boundaries and reports state, progress, and evidence of the result.
sents.zh: 每个一级智能体在其职责范围内行动，并报告状态、进度和结果的证据。

paragraphs.en: Handle exceptions at the right level. Local deviations are corrected locally. Issues affecting coordination go to the level-two agent. Matters beyond that agent’s authority go to personnel.
paragraphs.zh: 在合适的层级处理异常。 局部偏差在本地修正。 影响协作的问题上报给二级智能体。 超出该智能体权限的事项交给人员处理。

sents.en: Handle exceptions at the right level.
sents.zh: 在合适的层级处理异常。

sents.en: Local deviations are corrected locally.
sents.zh: 局部偏差在本地修正。

sents.en: Issues affecting coordination go to the level-two agent.
sents.zh: 影响协作的问题上报给二级智能体。

sents.en: Matters beyond that agent’s authority go to personnel.
sents.zh: 超出该智能体权限的事项交给人员处理。

paragraphs.en: Check completion. The level-two agent brings together subtask results and acceptance evidence. It checks the overall production requirements and reports the outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 检查完成情况。 二级智能体汇总各子任务结果与验收证据。 它检查整体生产要求并报告结果。

sents.en: Check completion.
sents.zh: 检查完成情况。

sents.en: The level-two agent brings together subtask results and acceptance evidence.
sents.zh: 二级智能体汇总各子任务结果与验收证据。

sents.en: It checks the overall production requirements and reports the outcome.
sents.zh: 它检查整体生产要求并报告结果。

paragraphs.en: Improve under control. Execution and coordination records inform evaluated updates to individual agents and the organization.
paragraphs.zh: 在受控状态下改进。 执行与协调记录为对各个智能体及组织的评估性更新提供依据。

sents.en: Improve under control.
sents.zh: 在受控状态下改进。

sents.en: Execution and coordination records inform evaluated updates to individual agents and the organization.
sents.zh: 执行与协调记录为对各个智能体及组织的评估性更新提供依据。

paragraphs.en: This arrangement connects management decisions to physical action through feedback at each level. People set goals and boundaries, resolve escalated issues, and make high-risk decisions. They need not continuously direct every permitted local adjustment.
paragraphs.zh: 这种安排通过每一层级的反馈将管理决策与实际操作连接起来。 人们设定目标和边界，解决上报的问题，并做出高风险决策。 他们无需持续指导每一项被允许的局部调整。

sents.en: This arrangement connects management decisions to physical action through feedback at each level.
sents.zh: 这种安排通过每一层级的反馈将管理决策与实际操作连接起来。

sents.en: People set goals and boundaries, resolve escalated issues, and make high-risk decisions.
sents.zh: 人们设定目标和边界，解决上报的问题，并做出高风险决策。

sents.en: They need not continuously direct every permitted local adjustment.
sents.zh: 他们无需持续指导每一项被允许的局部调整。

paragraphs.en: This section discusses the role of the proposed RAA framework in next-generation intelligent production. It places RAA within the evolution of manufacturing paradigms and explains how its mechanisms support intelligence, openness, and system-wide integration.
paragraphs.zh: 本节讨论所提出的 RAA 框架在下一代智能生产中的作用。 它将 RAA 置于制造范式的演进之中，并解释其机制如何支持智能化、开放性与系统级集成。

sents.en: This section discusses the role of the proposed RAA framework in next-generation intelligent production.
sents.zh: 本节讨论所提出的 RAA 框架在下一代智能生产中的作用。

sents.en: It places RAA within the evolution of manufacturing paradigms and explains how its mechanisms support intelligence, openness, and system-wide integration.
sents.zh: 它将 RAA 置于制造范式的演进之中，并解释其机制如何支持智能化、开放性与系统级集成。

paragraphs.en: The design addresses a broader development in manufacturing. Early mechanization and electrification increased the physical capacity of equipment. Computer and numerical-control technologies later made it possible to encode and repeat production operations. Digital tools also expanded into design and management. Computer-aided design (CAD) represented product information. Enterprise resource planning (ERP) supported the planning of orders, materials, and resources. Manufacturing execution systems (MES) organized and tracked shop-floor work [ 14 ] . These developments improved individual activities, even when information remained separated between systems.
paragraphs.zh: 该设计回应了制造业中一个更广泛的发展趋势。 早期的机械化和电气化提高了设备的物理能力。 计算机和数控技术随后使生产操作的编码与重复执行成为可能。 数字工具还扩展到了设计和管理领域。 计算机辅助设计（CAD）用于表示产品信息。 企业资源计划（ERP）支持对订单、物料和资源的规划。 制造执行系统（MES）对车间工作进行组织和跟踪 [ 14 ] 。 这些发展改善了单项活动，即使信息在各系统之间仍然是分离的。

sents.en: The design addresses a broader development in manufacturing.
sents.zh: 该设计回应了制造业中一个更广泛的发展趋势。

sents.en: Early mechanization and electrification increased the physical capacity of equipment.
sents.zh: 早期的机械化和电气化提高了设备的物理能力。

sents.en: Computer and numerical-control technologies later made it possible to encode and repeat production operations.
sents.zh: 计算机和数控技术随后使生产操作的编码与重复执行成为可能。

sents.en: Digital tools also expanded into design and management.
sents.zh: 数字工具还扩展到了设计和管理领域。

sents.en: Computer-aided design (CAD) represented product information.
sents.zh: 计算机辅助设计（CAD）用于表示产品信息。

sents.en: Enterprise resource planning (ERP) supported the planning of orders, materials, and resources.
sents.zh: 企业资源计划（ERP）支持对订单、物料和资源的规划。

sents.en: Manufacturing execution systems (MES) organized and tracked shop-floor work [ 14 ] .
sents.zh: 制造执行系统（MES）对车间工作进行组织和跟踪 [ 14 ] 。

sents.en: These developments improved individual activities, even when information remained separated between systems.
sents.zh: 这些发展改善了单项活动，即使信息在各系统之间仍然是分离的。

paragraphs.en: Networks extended information exchange across equipment, departments, and enterprises. The Industrial Internet of Things, cyber-physical systems, and digital twins further connected field conditions to planning and control [ 9 , 13 ] . Such connections make coordinated work possible, but they do not remove the need for a decision process when circumstances fall outside a fixed plan.
paragraphs.zh: 网络将信息交换扩展到了设备、部门和企业之间。 工业物联网、信息物理系统和数字孪生进一步将现场状况与计划和控制连接起来 [ 9 , 13 ] 。 这种连接使协同工作成为可能，但当情况超出固定计划时，它们并不能消除对决策过程的需要。

sents.en: Networks extended information exchange across equipment, departments, and enterprises.
sents.zh: 网络将信息交换扩展到了设备、部门和企业之间。

sents.en: The Industrial Internet of Things, cyber-physical systems, and digital twins further connected field conditions to planning and control [ 9 , 13 ] .
sents.zh: 工业物联网、信息物理系统和数字孪生进一步将现场状况与计划和控制连接起来 [ 9 , 13 ] 。

sents.en: Such connections make coordinated work possible, but they do not remove the need for a decision process when circumstances fall outside a fixed plan.
sents.zh: 这种连接使协同工作成为可能，但当情况超出固定计划时，它们并不能消除对决策过程的需要。

paragraphs.en: Zhou et al. [ 13 ] and Zang et al. [ 12 ] describe three basic paradigms: digital manufacturing, digital and networked manufacturing, and new-generation intelligent manufacturing. The first embeds existing knowledge in software and programs. The second connects information and resources. The third integrates new-generation AI with manufacturing so that systems can learn, apply knowledge, and adapt decisions to operating conditions.
paragraphs.zh: Zhou 等人[13]和 Zang 等人 [12]描述了三种基本范式：数字化制造、数字化与网络化制造，以及新一代智能制造。 第一种范式将已有知识嵌入软件和程序中。 第二种范式连接信息与资源。 第三种范式将新一代人工智能与制造相融合，使系统能够学习、运用知识，并根据运行状况调整决策。

sents.en: Zhou et al. [ 13 ] and Zang et al.
sents.zh: Zhou 等人[13]和 Zang 等人

sents.en: [ 12 ] describe three basic paradigms: digital manufacturing, digital and networked manufacturing, and new-generation intelligent manufacturing.
sents.zh: [12]描述了三种基本范式：数字化制造、数字化与网络化制造，以及新一代智能制造。

sents.en: The first embeds existing knowledge in software and programs.
sents.zh: 第一种范式将已有知识嵌入软件和程序中。

sents.en: The second connects information and resources.
sents.zh: 第二种范式连接信息与资源。

sents.en: The third integrates new-generation AI with manufacturing so that systems can learn, apply knowledge, and adapt decisions to operating conditions.
sents.zh: 第三种范式将新一代人工智能与制造相融合，使系统能够学习、运用知识，并根据运行状况调整决策。

paragraphs.en: The first two paradigms leave two related difficulties. Separate digital systems may use incompatible formats or interfaces. People then transfer information and translate plans between them. Connected systems can reduce this separation, but a revised management plan may still fail to produce a timely change in equipment behavior [ 10 , 5 ] . A system may detect a failed machine without being able to reorganize the affected work.
paragraphs.zh: 前两种范式留下了两个相关的困难。 分离的数字系统可能使用不兼容的格式或接口。 人们因此需要在它们之间转移信息并转译计划。 互联的系统可以减少这种分离，但修订后的管理计划仍可能无法及时改变设备的行为 [ 10 , 5 ] 。 一个系统可能检测到故障机器，却无法重组受影响的工作。

paragraphs.en: Recent work on large language model (LLM) agents illustrates ways to strengthen the link from production requirements to action. Xia et al. [ 11 ] connect task descriptions to planning and equipment skill invocation in a modular production setting. Fan et al. [ 1 ] examine LLM support for autonomous industrial robotics. These developments motivate a framework that connects local decision capability to the organization of multiple production units.
paragraphs.zh: 近期关于大语言模型（LLM）智能体的研究展示了强化从生产需求到行动之间联系的方法。Xia 等人 [ 11 ] 在模块化生产环境中将任务描述与规划和设备技能调用相连接。Fan 等人 [ 1 ] 研究了 LLM 对自主工业机器人的支持。 这些进展促使我们构建一个将本地决策能力与多个生产单元的组织相连接的框架。

paragraphs.en: Intelligence, openness, and system-wide integration are key characteristics in Zhou’s account of next-generation intelligent manufacturing [ 15 ] . Figure 3 illustrates how the RAA framework supports intelligence, openness, and system-wide integration through its engineering mechanisms.

paragraphs.en: A production unit must interpret its objective, act using current conditions, and check whether the result is acceptable. When it detects a deviation, it adjusts the plan within its authority. Experience can improve later decisions through controlled updates. RAA connects these functions in the local agent. This is intended to reduce dependence on fixed programs and repeated manual intervention when conditions change [ 10 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 生产单元必须理解其目标，根据当前条件采取行动，并检查结果是否可接受。 当它检测到偏差时，会在其权限范围内调整计划。 经验可以通过受控的更新来改进后续决策。 RAA 在本地智能体中连接这些功能。 旨在减少当条件变化时对固定程序和重复人工干预的依赖 [ 10 ] 。

paragraphs.en: An open production organization needs to know what a new unit can provide and under what conditions. Standardized descriptions, including the Asset Administration Shell, support a common representation of equipment information [ 3 ] . RAA uses capability contracts to connect such descriptions to task selection and execution requirements. Material, time, and resource needs must be understood before capabilities can be combined.
paragraphs.zh: 一个开放的生产组织需要了解新单元能提供什么，以及在什么条件下提供。 标准化描述（包括资产管理壳）支持设备信息的统一表示 [ 3 ] 。 RAA 使用能力契约将此类描述与任务选择和执行要求相连接。 在组合能力之前，必须先理解物料、时间和资源需求。

paragraphs.en: Production units need to contribute to the overall delivery objective. They must also cooperate with activities such as design, logistics, and services [ 13 , 5 ] . A station cannot plan only for its own convenience when another task depends on its output. Shared resources and handoffs connect local choices to broader results. RAA carries goals downward and brings results upward through the same pattern at each level. A team-like organization resolves issues within its scope and escalates those that affect a broader group. This mirrors the functional links between operators, teams, workshops, and factories. Coordination gives local action an organizational context and helps prevent local optimization from undermining the overall task.
paragraphs.zh: 生产单元需要为整体交付目标作出贡献。 它们还必须与设计、物流和服务等活动协作 [ 13 , 5 ] 。 当另一项任务依赖其产出时，一个工位不能只为自身的便利进行规划。 共享资源和交接将局部选择与更广泛的结果联系起来。 RAA 通过在每个层级采用相同的模式，将目标向下传递，并将结果向上汇报。 团队式的组织在其职责范围内解决问题，并将影响更广群体的问题逐级上报。 这反映了操作员、团队、车间和工厂之间的功能性联系。 协调赋予局部行动以组织层面的背景，并有助于防止局部优化损害整体任务。

paragraphs.en: These three requirements reinforce one another. A unit that can adapt but cannot describe its capabilities is difficult to compose into larger tasks. Connected units that cannot decide locally still depend on external instructions. Autonomous units without coordination can interfere with one another. Local feedback, capability contracts, and recursive organization are intended to address these needs together.
paragraphs.zh: 这三个要求相互强化。 一个能够适应但无法描述自身能力的智能体，很难被组合进更大的任务中。 无法在本地决策的互联智能体仍然依赖外部指令。 缺乏协调的自主智能体之间可能相互干扰。 本地反馈、能力契约和递归式组织旨在共同满足这些需求。

paragraphs.en: Deployment can start with a workstation or production-line segment that offers clear practical value. The enterprise can establish the sensing, connectivity, and decision capability needed for that task, then extend the organization using validated units. Factory-wide transformation need not be a prerequisite for every local application. This is relevant to enterprises with limited funding or technical staff [ 8 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 部署可以从一个工作站或生产线环节开始，只要该环节能带来明确的实际价值。 企业可以先建立完成该任务所需的感知、连接与决策能力，然后利用经过验证的单元来扩展整个组织。 全厂范围的转型不必成为每个局部应用的前提条件。 这对资金或技术人员有限的企业尤为重要 [ 8 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Production intelligence concerns how a system selects actions under changing conditions and revises them through feedback. A CAS perspective brings two mechanisms into focus. Individual autonomy forms local decisions using available information. Collective coordination manages the dependencies that determine whether those decisions can work together. Learning and adaptation improve both mechanisms over time. The RAA framework turns this account into an organization of agents and coordinated groups. Goal contracts guide local work. Capability contracts support participant selection and composition. Recursive interfaces connect equipment, production lines, and factories, while feedback connects results to decisions at each level. Checked execution, local recovery, escalation, and controlled learning preserve the role of operating boundaries throughout this design. RAA provides an engineering approach to next-generation intelligent manufacturing. It connects local autonomy with recursive coordination to support intelligence, openness, and system-wide integration.
paragraphs.zh: 生产智能关注的是一个系统如何在变化的条件下选择动作，并通过反馈对这些动作进行修订。 CAS（复杂适应系统）视角 brings 两个机制 into focus。改为：CAS（复杂适应系统）视角使两个机制进入焦点。 个体自主性利用可获得的信息形成局部决策。 群体协调管理那些决定这些决策能否协同工作的依赖关系。 学习与适应随时间推移改进这两个机制。 RAA 框架将这一论述转化为一种由智能体和协同群组构成的组织结构。 目标契约指导局部工作。 能力契约支持参与者的选择与组合。 递归接口连接设备、生产线和工厂，而反馈将各层级的结果与决策联系起来。 受控执行、局部恢复、升级上报和受控学习在整个设计中保持了运行边界的作用。 RAA 为下一代智能制造提供了一种工程化方法。 它将局部自主性与递归协调相连接，以支持智能性、开放性和全系统集成。
